evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands a cadence and frames non-compliance as capability loss, a consequence-for-absence that binds the organization to his standing order.
Declarative restatement of the mandated cadence reinforces the directive's authority-ranking force — the owner is specifying the organizational rhythm.
Self-attribution of the 'Owner' role enacts authority-ranking by claiming positional authority over the rehearsal process.

mints.name: MandateByConsequenceFraming
mints.title: a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted by framing the absence of a practice as the absence of a capability?
